meta.purpose: Question family definitions for Fringe Interview.
notes: Each family groups interview questions by investigative intent.
Families are selected from interviewPlan.suggestedQuestionFamilies and focusBlocks.
Questions are written in English because the interview simulator currently operates in English.

general_fit.label: General Fit
recommendedWhen: default fallback family
general role fit needs exploration
no more specific family is clearly selected
questions: Can you walk me through your background and explain why this role feels like a logical next step for you?
Which parts of your experience do you think are most relevant to this position?
What kind of work environment helps you perform at your best?
What would make you a strong fit for this role beyond the obvious skill match?

ownership_scope.label: Ownership Scope
ownership_scope.intent: understand initiative ownership, accountability, and end-to-end responsibility
recommendedWhen: ownership scope is unclear
delivery ownership is weak or partial
the role expects end-to-end responsibility
questions: Tell me about a piece of work that you personally owned from start to finish.
How do you distinguish between supporting an initiative and truly owning it?
Can you describe a situation where you were accountable for an outcome, not just a task?
What decisions were yours to make in your most relevant project?

stakeholder_management.label: Stakeholder Management
stakeholder_management.intent: understand influence, alignment, and communication across stakeholders
recommendedWhen: stakeholder management is important in the role
the CV suggests communication but scope is unclear
senior stakeholder exposure needs validation
questions: Tell me about a time when you had to align people with different priorities.
How have you handled stakeholder expectations when you could not satisfy everyone at once?
What level of stakeholders have you regularly worked with, and in what context?
Can you give an example of how you influenced a decision without formal authority?

transferability.label: Transferability
transferability.intent: test whether adjacent experience can transfer into the target role
recommendedWhen: candidate has adjacent but not direct experience
domain gap exists but is not structural
growth potential is relevant
questions: Your background is close to this role but not identical. What makes you confident the transition would work?
Which parts of your previous experience transfer most directly into this role?
What would be the steepest learning curve for you in this position, and how would you handle it?
Can you describe a past situation where you successfully adapted to a new domain or context?

analytical_depth.label: Analytical Depth
analytical_depth.intent: test depth of analysis, reporting quality, metrics thinking, and structured reasoning
recommendedWhen: the role requires analysis, reporting, KPI work, or SQL/BI usage
analytical strengths must be validated
surface claims need depth testing
questions: Tell me about a reporting or analysis task that became more complex than expected. How did you handle it?
How do you decide which metrics really matter in a recurring dashboard or report?
Can you describe a time when your analysis changed a decision or improved an operational outcome?
When working with incomplete or messy data, how do you make sure your conclusions remain reliable?

seniority_calibration.label: Seniority Calibration
seniority_calibration.intent: verify whether the candidate is operating at the level required by the role
recommendedWhen: seniority signals are ambiguous
role level may exceed visible candidate scope
candidate may be transitioning upward
questions: How has the scope of your responsibilities changed over the last few years?
What kinds of problems are you now trusted to handle independently?
How would you describe the level at which you currently operate: execution, coordination, ownership, or strategic influence?
What evidence from your recent work best shows you are ready for the next level?

communication_clarity.label: Communication Clarity
communication_clarity.intent: assess how clearly the candidate structures and explains work
recommendedWhen: communication is important in the role
CV language is vague or generic
reporting or stakeholder-facing work requires clarity
questions: Explain a complex piece of work you did in a way a non-specialist could understand.
Tell me about a time when poor communication created friction. What did you do?
How do you adapt your message when speaking to technical versus non-technical stakeholders?
When presenting updates, how do you decide what to include and what to leave out?

leadership_scope.label: Leadership Scope
leadership_scope.intent: understand people leadership, mentoring, and influence scope
recommendedWhen: leadership signals are partial or unclear
the role values mentoring or people influence
candidate may have unofficial leadership experience
questions: Have you ever led or guided others, even without formal management authority?
Tell me about a time when someone relied on you for direction or support.
What does leadership mean in your current kind of role?
How have you helped raise the quality of work around you?
